belief_records.strategy: Cooperate with likely good players to maximize good-player welfare; defect when facing selfish behavior.
Cooperate with good players to increase their combined payoff; use observed actions and encounter history to adapt.
Defect: this is a one-time encounter, and D gives a higher payoff than C against either opponent action.
